answers_to_research_questions.q1_most_influential_feature: 'loan_amount' ranks first by mean absolute SHAP in this saved report (mean absolute SHAP 1.6742). Permutation importance also ranks loan_amount first in this saved report. The measures can differ because permutation importance measures the performance change when a feature is shuffled.
answers_to_research_questions.q2_measured_contribution: Mean absolute SHAP value is 1.6742 on the Gradient Boosting model's raw output scale.
answers_to_research_questions.q3_performance_decline_on_removal: In the previously saved ablation experiment, ROC-AUC changed from 0.9497 to 0.8211 (change -0.1285). However, the old full-model class metrics used threshold 0.46 while the reduced-model class metrics used 0.50, so accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 deltas should be regenerated before comparing.
answers_to_research_questions.q4_do_other_features_provide_value: In the previously saved experiment, the model without loan_amount had held-out ROC-AUC 0.8211 versus 0.9497 for the full model. This suggests other features retain predictive signal on this split, but does not prove independence from the removed feature or real-world usefulness.
answers_to_research_questions.q5_stability_across_folds: The held-out mean-absolute-SHAP top feature is 'loan_amount'. The recorded cross-validation folds rank cibil_score first by tree impurity importance. The metrics differ, so this disagreement is a reason to inspect both rankings rather than claim stability across all folds.
answers_to_research_questions.q6_multicollinearity_and_redundancy: Found 1 numerical feature pair(s) with absolute Pearson correlation above 0.50. income_annum / loan_amount (0.68)
answers_to_research_questions.q7_synthetic_rule_vs_complex_pattern: The exact synthetic label-generation rule cannot be established from model results alone. Inspect the original data-generation process if available. High test scores can reflect patterns built into synthetic labels and do not establish performance on real lending data.
answers_to_research_questions.q8_limitations: The data is synthetic/simulated; findings reflect the simulation generating process rather than actual institutional underwriting policies. Real lending decisions incorporate credit history depth, debt service ratios, verified employment, and subjective underwriter review.
